name: code-en
description: code-en is a subset of the Multilingual Reward Bench focusing on code-related preference data in English. It provides human (or human-like) preference labels over generated code outputs to support training and evaluation of reward and preference models for code generation. The benchmark is used to measure how well models predict human preferences and rank code outputs.
reputation: Niche dataset used in reward-modeling and preference-alignment research; modest but growing adoption among researchers working on alignment for code models.
